title: make gate flaked once on this host; the failing package was not captured
body: The first `make gate` invocation on this worktree exited 1, but the failing package's FAIL line scrolled out of the tail used to watch it, so it could not be attributed. Two subsequent fully uncached invocations (GOFLAGS="-p=2 -count=1" GOTEST_PARALLEL=4 make gate) exited 0 with no FAIL anywhere in the log. The learnings already record wall-clock tests on this shared host refusing innocent work; this may be another instance. Not attributable to this tick's diff, which touches only internal/cli rendering and passed green in every run.
